rows.grounds: compound of prāṇa, ādi, and adjectival suffix; nominative plural feminine agreeing with mudrāḥ
future passive participle from dṛś, agreeing with mudrāḥ
instrumental singular of krama, indicating sequential manner

items.question: Which mudras beginning with prana are to be seen in order?
premises: Prana and related mudras are named.
items.inference: The verse prescribes viewing prana mudras sequentially.
uncertainties: Exact list of prana mudras is not given in this verse.
items.plain_english: The prana and other mudras are indeed to be seen in order.
